summary: Innovative Industrial Properties, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the termination of an existing equity distribution agreement with Jefferies LLC and the entry into a new, substantially similar agreement with Huntington Securities, Inc. under its $500 million at-the-market (ATM) program for common stock and Series A preferred stock. The filing is a routine capital markets update, not a special situation. No material terms changes, strategic actions, or corporate events are disclosed. The 8-K serves as regulatory notice of counterparty changes under existing ATM arrangements. Investors may watch for future ATM issuances, but no actionable special-situation angle is present.
